about: [O8 after the critic] eight men stood ahead of my car (1.7 s of its way, or 0.8 s: a man stepping out late) in the city, one every 2.7 s, W held (35 to 90 km/h), every other one with his back to it: who clears, who freezes, who is hit; no body carried on the bumper

steps.eval: (() => { const c = G.city.car, P = G.people; P.dbgClear(); window.__R = []; window.__n = 0; const f = () => [Math.cos(c.yaw), -Math.sin(c.yaw)]; window.__put = () => { const F = f(), back = window.__n % 2 === 1, near = window.__n % 4 >= 2, d = Math.max(9, (near ? 0.8 : 1.7) * c.kmh / 3.6); const p = P.dbgWalker(c.pos.x + F[0] * d, c.pos.z + F[1] * d, back ? c.yaw + Math.PI / 2 + Math.PI / 2 : c.yaw + Math.PI / 2); const r = { i: window.__n++, kmh: Math.round(c.kmh), d: +d.toFixed(1), back, out: null, carried: 0 }; window.__R.push(r); const t0 = performance.now(); const iv = setInterval(() => { const dx = p.pos.x - c.pos.x, dz = p.pos.z - c.pos.z, ahead = dx * F[0] + dz * F[1], side = Math.abs(-dx * F[1] + dz * F[0]); if (p.down && ahead > 0 && side < 1.3 && ahead < c.spec.halfL + 1.2) r.carried += 1 / 30; if (!r.out && p.down) r.out = 'hit'; if (!r.out && p.mode === 'cower') r.froze = true; if (performance.now() - t0 > 2600) { if (!r.out) r.out = p.mode === 'dash' || p.mode === 'walk' ? 'clear' : p.mode; r.carried = +r.carried.toFixed(2); clearInterval(iv); } }, 33); }; window.__put(); return 'ok'; })()
JSON.stringify({ runs: window.__R, hit: window.__R.filter(r => r.out === 'hit').length, carriedMax: Math.max(...window.__R.map(r => r.carried)), stats: G.people.stats })
